lex_add.brief: 向词法分析器追加一个词法单元 / Append one token to the lexer

params.type: 词法单元类型（`T_*`）/ Token type (`T_*`)
params.num: 数值载荷（数字字面量用）/ Numeric payload (for number literals)
params.text: 词法单元文本；`NULL` 表示无文本 / Token text, or `NULL` for none

lex_add.note: 文本被复制到 js arena；容量不足时表翻倍并复制旧内容 / The text is copied into the JS arena; the table doubles and copies when full

lex_ident_start.brief: 判断字符能否作为标识符首字符 / Test whether a character can start an identifier

params.c: 待判断的字符 / Character to test

lex_ident_start.return: 可作首字符返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it may start an identifier, otherwise 0
lex_ident_start.note: 放行非 ASCII，使标识符可为中文 / Non-ASCII is allowed so identifiers may be Chinese

lex_ident_char.brief: 判断字符能否作为标识符后续字符 / Test whether a character may continue an identifier

params.c: 待判断的字符 / Character to test

lex_ident_char.return: 可作后续字符返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it may continue an identifier, otherwise 0

lex_hex_digit.brief: 求十六进制数位的值 / Convert a hex digit to its value

params.c: 待转换的字符 / Character to convert

lex_hex_digit.return: 0..15 的数位值；非十六进制字符返回 -1 / The digit value 0..15, or -1 when `c` is not a hex digit

lex_read_hex.brief: 从游标处读取至多 max 个十六进制数位 / Read up to `max` hex digits from the cursor

params.max: 最多读取的数位个数 / Maximum number of digits to read

lex_read_hex.return: 读到的数值（无有效数位为 0）/ The accumulated value (0 when no digit is read)
lex_read_hex.note: 游标停在第一个非十六进制字符处 / The cursor stops at the first non-hex character

lex_escape_simple.brief: 返回固定单字符转义对应的字符 / Map a fixed single-character escape to its character

params.e: 转义字母（反斜杠之后）/ The escape letter (after the backslash)

lex_escape_simple.return: 对应字符码；需要额外输入时返回 -1 / The character code, or -1 for escapes needing more input

lex_unicode_escape.brief: 解码 `\uXXXX` 或 `\u{XXXXX}` 转义 / Decode a `\uXXXX` or `\u{XXXXX}` escape

params.buf: out:接收 UTF-8 编码的缓冲区 / Buffer receiving the UTF-8 encoding
params.n: inout:已写入的字节数 / Bytes already written

lex_unicode_escape.note: 空间不足时静默丢弃；写入 `hpe_utf8_encode` 的结果 / Silently discards when the buffer is full; writes the output of `hpe_utf8_encode`

lex_escape.brief: 解码一个转义序列 / Decode one escape sequence

params.buf: out:接收解码结果的缓冲区 / Buffer receiving the decoded bytes
params.n: inout:已写入的字节数 / Bytes already written

lex_escape.note: 前导反斜杠已由调用方消费；支持 `\xHH`、`\u` 与行续接 / The leading backslash is already consumed; supports `\xHH`, `\u` and line continuation

lex_string.brief: 读取一个字符串字面量 / Scan a string literal

params.quote: 引号字符（`"` 或 `'`）/ The quote character (`"` or `'`)

lex_string.note: 结果作为 `T_STR` 词法单元加入；未闭合时报告语法错误 / The result is added as a `T_STR` token; an unterminated literal raises an error

lex_hex_number.brief: 读取十六进制数字字面量 / Scan a hexadecimal numeric literal

params.buf: out:接收数字字符的缓冲区 / Buffer receiving the digit characters
params.n: inout:已写入的字符数 / Characters already written

lex_hex_number.return: 解析出的浮点数值 / The parsed floating-point value
lex_hex_number.note: 跳过 `_` 分隔符；`0x` 前缀由调用方消费 / `_` separators are skipped; the caller consumes the `0x` prefix

lex_radix_number.brief: 读取二进制或八进制数字字面量 / Scan a binary or octal numeric literal

params.radix: 进制（2 或 8）/ The radix (2 or 8)

lex_radix_number.return: 解析出的浮点数值 / The parsed floating-point value
lex_radix_number.note: 跳过 `_` 分隔符；`0b`/`0o` 前缀由本函数消费 / `_` separators are skipped; this function consumes the `0b`/`0o` prefix

lex_decimal_number.brief: 读取十进制/小数/指数形式的数字 / Scan a decimal, fractional or exponent number

params.buf: out:接收数字字符的缓冲区 / Buffer receiving the digit characters
params.n: inout:已写入的字符数 / Characters already written

lex_decimal_number.return: 解析出的浮点数值 / The parsed floating-point value
lex_decimal_number.note: 跳过 `_` 分隔符；用 `strtod` 转换 / `_` separators are skipped; the value is parsed with `strtod`

lex_number.brief: 读取任意形式的数字字面量 / Scan a numeric literal of any form
lex_number.note: 按 `0x`/`0b`/`0o` 前缀分派；容忍 BigInt 后缀 `n`（仍按 double 存储）/ Dispatches on the `0x`/`0b`/`0o` prefix; tolerates a trailing BigInt `n` (still stored as a double)

lex_regex_allowed.brief: 判断当前位置的 `/` 是否开启正则字面量 / Decide whether a `/` here starts a regex literal
lex_regex_allowed.return: 为正则返回 1，为除号返回 0 / 1 for a regex, 0 when it is a division operator
lex_regex_allowed.note: 依据上一词法单元判断：表达式结束处或 `)`/`]`/`}`/`++`/`--` 之后是除号，`return`/`typeof` 等关键字之后是正则 / Decides from the previous token: after an expression end or `)`/`]`/`}`/`++`/`--` it is division, after `return`/`typeof` and similar keywords it is a regex

lex_regex_body.brief: 扫描 `/…/flags` 的正则体 / Scan the body of a `/…/flags` regex

params.start_line: 正则起始行号（用于报错）/ Line where the regex starts (for errors)

lex_regex_body.return: 闭合 `/` 的下标；未闭合时报告错误并返回 `lx->len` / The index of the closing `/`, or reports an error and returns `lx->len`
lex_regex_body.note: 跟踪 `[...]` 字符类与 `\` 转义 / Tracks `[...]` character classes and `\` escapes

lex_regex_emit.brief: 把正则的模式与标志存成一个词法单元 / Store a regex pattern and flags as one token

params.end: 闭合 `/` 的下标 / Index of the closing `/`
params.start_line: 正则起始行号 / Line where the regex starts

lex_regex_emit.note: 以 `pattern\0flags` 形式存为 `T_REGEX`，并推进游标 / Stored as `T_REGEX` in the form `pattern\0flags`; the cursor is advanced

lex_regex.brief: 读取一个正则字面量 / Scan a regex literal
lex_regex.note: 未闭合时直接返回而不产生词法单元 / Returns without emitting a token when unterminated

scan_skip_string.brief: 跳过一段引号字符串并统计换行 / Skip a quoted string while counting newlines

params.j: 起始下标（指向引号）/ Start index (pointing at the quote)
params.q: 引号字符 / The quote character
params.lines: inout:累计的换行数 / Running newline count

scan_skip_string.return: 越过闭合引号的下标 / The index just past the closing quote

scan_skip_substitution.brief: 越过一段 `${ … }` 替换体 / Advance past one `${ … }` substitution body

params.lines: inout:累计的换行数 / Running newline count

scan_skip_substitution.return: 越过闭合 `}` 的下标 / The index just past the closing `}`
scan_skip_substitution.note: 处理嵌套花括号、字符串、模板与注释 / Handles nested braces, strings, templates and comments

scan_template.brief: 扫描一个模板字面量 / Scan a template literal

params.i: 起始下标（指向反引号）/ Start index (pointing at the backtick)
params.lines: inout:累计的换行数 / Running newline count

scan_template.return: 越过闭合反引号的下标（出错时为 `len`）/ The index just past the closing backtick (`len` on error)
scan_template.note: 处理嵌套模板、`${}` 替换、字符串与注释 / Handles nested templates, `${}` substitutions, strings and comments

lex_template.brief: 读取一个模板字面量 / Scan a template literal
lex_template.note: 整段源码存为一个 `T_TEMPLATE` 词法单元；未闭合时报错 / The whole source is stored as one `T_TEMPLATE` token; raises an error when unterminated

lex_skip_trivia.brief: 跳过空白与注释 / Skip whitespace and comments
lex_skip_trivia.return: 消费了内容返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when something was consumed, otherwise 0
lex_skip_trivia.note: 处理 `//` 行注释与块注释，并统计换行 / Handles `//` line comments and block comments and keeps track of newlines

lex_match_punct.brief: 尝试匹配一个标点词法单元 / Try to match a punctuation token
lex_match_punct.return: 匹配到的长度（4/3/2/1）；不匹配返回 0 / The matched length (4/3/2/1), or 0 when nothing matches
lex_match_punct.note: 按 4→1 从长到短尝试标点表；`?.` 后紧跟数字时按三元运算符处理 / Tries the tables longest-first; `?.` followed by a digit is treated as a ternary

lex_at_number.brief: 判断游标处是否为数字字面量开头 / Test whether the cursor starts a numeric literal
lex_at_number.return: 是数字返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for a number, otherwise 0
lex_at_number.note: 同时识别 `123` 与 `.5` 形式 / Recognises both `123` and `.5`

lex_all.brief: 把整段源码词法分析为词法单元序列 / Tokenise the whole source into the token list
lex_all.note: 循环分派到字符串/模板/正则/数字/标识符/标点，末尾追加 `T_EOF` / Dispatches to string, template, regex, number, identifier and punctuation; appends a final `T_EOF`

p_cur.brief: 取当前词法单元 / Return the current token
p_cur.return: 指向当前词法单元的指针 / Pointer to the current token

p_at.brief: 取相对当前偏移 i 的词法单元 / Return the token at offset `i` from the cursor
p_at.return: 指向该词法单元的指针；越界时钳到最后一个（`T_EOF`）/ Pointer to that token; clamped to the last one (`T_EOF`) when out of range

p_is.brief: 判断当前词法单元是否为给定标点 / Test whether the current token is the given punctuation
p_is.return: 匹配返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on a match, otherwise 0

p_is_ident.brief: 判断当前词法单元是否为给定标识符 / Test whether the current token is the given identifier

params.word: 单词文本 / The word text

p_is_ident.return: 匹配返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on a match, otherwise 0

p_is_ident_at.brief: 判断偏移 i 处的词法单元是否为给定标识符 / Test whether the token at offset `i` is the given identifier

params.word: 单词文本 / The word text

p_is_ident_at.return: 匹配返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on a match, otherwise 0

p_line.brief: 取当前词法单元的行号 / Return the current token's line number
p_line.return: 当前行号 / The current line number

p_advance.brief: 推进解析游标一个词法单元 / Advance the parse cursor by one token
p_advance.note: 已到 `T_EOF` 时不再前进 / Stops advancing once at `T_EOF`

p_expect.brief: 断言当前词法单元为指定标点并前进 / Assert the current token is `punct` and advance

params.punct: 期望的标点串 / The expected punctuation string

p_expect.warning: 不匹配时报告语法错误 / Reports a syntax error on mismatch

p_at_statement_end.brief: 消费语句结束（`;` 或自动分号插入）/ Consume a statement end (`;` or automatic semicolon insertion)
p_at_statement_end.return: 认为语句已结束返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the statement is treated as ended, otherwise 0
p_at_statement_end.note: `;`、`}`、`T_EOF` 或下一词法单元换行时均视为结束 / `;`, `}`, `T_EOF` or a line break before the next token all count as an end

p_reserved.brief: 判断单词是否为不可作绑定名的保留字 / Test whether a word is a reserved word that may not be a binding name

params.word: 待判断的单词 / Word to test

p_reserved.return: 是保留字返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when reserved, otherwise 0

p_node.brief: 在当前行新建一个 AST 节点 / Allocate a new AST node at the current line
p_node.return: 新建的 AST 节点（存于 arena）/ The new AST node (allocated from the arena)

p_skip_balanced.brief: 跳过从 start 开始的成对括号组 / Skip a balanced (), [] or {} group starting at `start`

params.start: 组起始词法单元下标 / Token index where the group starts

p_skip_balanced.return: 越过闭合符号的下标；不配对返回 -1 / The index just past the closing token, or -1 when unbalanced

p_pattern_start.brief: 判断当前位置是否开始一个解构模式 / Test whether `[` or `{` here starts a destructuring pattern
p_pattern_start.return: 是模式开头返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when a pattern starts here, otherwise 0
p_pattern_start.note: 用于区分解构模式与数组/对象字面量 / Used to tell a destructuring pattern from an array/object literal

p_binding_array.brief: 解析 `[a, b, ...rest]` 数组解构绑定 / Parse an `[a, b, ...rest]` array binding pattern

p_binding_obj_pair.brief: 解析对象解构模式中的一项 / Parse one entry of an object binding pattern

params.obj: inout:模式节点 / The pattern node

p_binding_obj_pair.note: 覆盖 `{key: target}`、`{key = default}` 与 `{key}` 三种形式 / Covers `{key: target}`, `{key = default}` and `{key}`

p_binding_object.brief: 解析 `{a, b: c, ...rest}` 对象解构绑定 / Parse a `{a, b: c, ...rest}` object binding pattern

p_binding_target.brief: 解析一个绑定目标 / Parse a binding target
p_binding_target.return: 标识符、数组或对象模式节点 / An identifier, array or object pattern node
p_binding_target.note: 在非严格位置宽容接受保留字作名字 / Tolerates reserved words as names in non-strict positions

p_binding_element.brief: 解析一个参数或数组元素 / Parse a parameter or an array element
p_binding_element.return: 目标、带默认值的 `JS_N_PAT_DEFAULT` 或 `JS_N_PAT_REST` 节点 / A target, a `JS_N_PAT_DEFAULT`, or a `JS_N_PAT_REST` node
p_binding_element.note: 覆盖 `target`、`target = default` 与 `...target` / Covers `target`, `target = default` and `...target`
